publicationGate.reason: The disk installer has not yet been installed onto a separate disposable QEMU disk, rebooted, and verified not to expose the live boot media as a writable target.
requiredEvidence: Install onto a separate disposable virtual target disk.
Reboot from the installed virtual disk and reach the Centipede desktop.
Verify the live source medium remained read-only and unavailable as an install target.
Pass the BIOS and UEFI live-image boot matrix.

desktop.description: Built web application bundle; requires a web server and an independently operated Kingdom service.

iso.description: Centipede-branded hybrid live image with custom boot menus, startup splash, desktop, login, and installer identity; XFCE desktop, free everyday apps, and guided disk installer. Disk install safety remains under validation; always back up data before proceeding.

live-usb.description: Same Centipede-branded hybrid live and guided installer image bytes with a USB-specific filename, validated byte-identical and writable to USB media. Writing it erases the selected USB.

vm.description: QEMU qcow2 optical-media image converted from the Centipede-branded live and guided installer image; attach as virtual CD media, not as an installed system disk.

android.description: Publisher-signed Capacitor Android APK, checked against a pinned certificate fingerprint and launched in an Android emulator.

ios.description: Capacitor iOS device app; stable device distribution requires Apple distribution signing and provisioning. TestFlight upload is outside this workflow.
ios.reason: Stable iPhone IPA publication is disabled until Apple distribution signing/provisioning credentials are configured; simulator build is validation only.

docker.description: Built and smoke-tested Docker image exported as a loadable image tar archive.
